effect_description_eng:
Your Digimon with [Omnimon] in its name can digivolve into this card in your hand for a cost of 3, ignoring digivolution requirements.
[When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP.
[Opponent's Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, by trashing 2 of this Digimon's digivolution cards, end the attack.
